title: IAM policy grants unrestricted actions on all resources
description: The inline policy 'lab-full-admin' attached to user 'lab-admin-console-nomfa' contains an Allow statement for Action "*" on all resources. The statement grants every action against every resource in the account. This reports the shape of the policy document; it does not evaluate service control policies, permissions boundaries, or session policies that may constrain the principal in practice.
remediation: Replace the wildcard statement with the specific actions the workload calls, scoped to specific resource ARNs. Derive the action list from CloudTrail or IAM Access Analyzer policy generation rather than guessing.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: Bucket ACL grants public access
description: The ACL on bucket 'lab-public-assets' grants READ to the global group(s) AllUsers. IgnorePublicAcls is not enabled, so the grants are effective.
remediation: Remove the global-group grants from the bucket ACL, then enable Block Public Access so the grant cannot be reintroduced.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: Bucket policy grants access to a public principal
description: The bucket policy on 'lab-public-assets' contains an Allow statement with an anonymous principal. The statements grant access to anonymous callers without any condition.
remediation: Scope the Principal to specific account or role ARNs. If the bucket must serve public content, front it with CloudFront and an origin access control rather than a public bucket policy.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: CloudTrail trail exists but is not currently logging
description: Trail 'lab-single-region-trail' is configured but GetTrailStatus reports that logging is stopped. It appears correctly configured in any configuration-only review while recording nothing.
remediation: Start logging on the trail and investigate why it stopped. For delivery errors, check the destination bucket policy, the bucket's existence, and the KMS key policy if the trail is encrypted.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: Console-enabled IAM user lacks MFA
description: IAM user 'lab-admin-console-nomfa' has a console login profile but no MFA device is registered, so interactive sign-in is protected by a password alone.
remediation: Register a virtual or hardware MFA device for the user, or delete the login profile if the identity only needs programmatic access.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: Active IAM access key exceeds maximum age
description: Access key AKIA…UDGX for user 'lab-svc-stale-keys' is 400 days old, above the configured rotation threshold of 90 days and above the escalation threshold of 180 days. Key age is credential metadata; it does not by itself indicate that the key has been used or compromised.
remediation: Create a replacement key, migrate dependent workloads, then deactivate and delete the superseded key. Prefer IAM roles or IAM Identity Center over long-lived user keys where the workload allows it.
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0

title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail configured
description: All 1 configured trail(s) are single-region, so activity in any other region is not captured. Regions an organisation does not use are exactly where unmonitored activity tends to occur.
remediation: Convert an existing trail to multi-region (IsMultiRegionTrail with IncludeGlobalServiceEvents), or create a dedicated multi-region trail.

title: CloudTrail log file validation is disabled

remediation: Enable log file validation on the trail (update-trail --enable-log-file-validation).

title: Bucket policy grants access to a public principal
description: The bucket policy on 'lab-partner-share' contains an Allow statement with an anonymous principal. The condition needs manual review; a scanner cannot tell whether the named range is trusted.
remediation: Scope the Principal to specific account or role ARNs. If the bucket must serve public content, front it with CloudFront and an origin access control rather than a public bucket policy.

title: No explicit bucket-level encryption configuration observed
description: GetBucketEncryption returned no bucket-level default encryption configuration for 'lab-public-assets'. Amazon S3 has applied SSE-S3 to new objects by default since January 2023, so this records the absence of an explicit, auditable configuration rather than asserting that stored objects are unencrypted.
remediation: Set an explicit default encryption configuration (SSE-S3, or SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key where key-level access control or auditing is required).
compliance_framework: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0
